name: sunny-white-outfit-summer-cafe
image_purpose: Instagram carousel or summer fashion grid

prompt.project_info: Create a clean four-panel summer lifestyle fashion collage of an approved adult woman enjoying a green iced drink by a modern outdoor cafe.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long loose hair and relaxed, confident, smiling, and neutral expressions across the panels. She wears the reference's white athletic set, white sneakers with crew socks, black shoulder bag, and minimal jewelry, preserving the original sporty silhouette with natural proportions.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 portrait grid: casual standing, leaning beside the planter, smiling with the drink, and comfortable crouching pose. Keep subject scale, outfit, bag, green drink, and background consistent across all four images.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with soft shadows, white modern building and wooden pergola, lush vines, pale stone flooring, airy fresh summer feel.
prompt.technical_specs: Lifestyle fashion photography, four portrait images combined, 50mm look, moderate depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain, clean natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clean 2x2 portrait grid collage of one approved adult blonde woman with long loose hair enjoying a green iced drink beside a modern outdoor cafe walkway. Across four panels she stands casually, leans beside a planter, smiles while holding a clear cup with straw, and crouches comfortably. She wears the reference's white athletic set with safe coverage, white sneakers with crew socks, black shoulder bag, and minimal jewelry. White modern building with wooden pergola, lush green vines, pale stone flooring, natural daylight with soft shadows, fresh sunny stylish summer atmosphere, consistent outfit, bag, drink, subject scale, and environment, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, childlike appearance, distorted hands, extra fingers, inconsistent outfit, duplicate subject, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random logos, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
